scope: New allocation/orchestration controls only. All target filesystem calls mocked. No model or original evidence access; prior 33 controls not rerun.

controls.name: exact arguments admitted without filesystem access
all other result allocations refused before filesystem access
existing result refused without parent creation
existing parent refused without parent reuse
absent allocation creates exactly one exclusive parent
exclusive mkdir collision propagates without reuse
allocation helper independently refuses wrong output
successful orchestration allocates before all actual reads
pure argument refusal never allocates or accesses evidence
allocation refusal never accesses evidence or writes reused parent
downstream refusal is preserved after fresh allocation and re-raised
exclusive refusal record retains requested authority and false claims
existing refusal record cannot be overwritten
